desc: This STU 3 Ballot publication adds guidance for communicating data requirements for measure sets, as well as significant improvements in composite measure representation and calculation, including the ability to define composites that include a mixture of proportion, ratio, and continuous-variable components. For a complete list of changes to this version, refer to the change log.
